newsitem.title: UK: Guardian Royal, Northern Rock in venture.
newsitem.headline: Guardian Royal, Northern Rock in venture.

text.p: Guardian Royal Exchange Group said it had set up a strategic partnership with Northern Rock Building Society to provide general insurance products to the society's 190,000 customers.
In a statement, Guardian Royal said the new service would be launched on January 1, 1997 and premium income in the first year of operation was expected to total around 65 million stg.

"We believe this new partnership is strongly positioned to develop a range of innovative products to meet the needs of members of the society," Guardian Insurance managing director Alan Thompson said in a statement.
"In due course we will also develop a range of other products to market to the society's customer base," he said.
